svg.title: BCBC 2024 · 9.24.3.5 Framing around Openings
svg.text: BCBC 2024 · DIVISION B · PART 9 HOUSING AND SMALL BUILDINGS · SECTION 9.24 SHEET STEEL STUD WALL FRAMING

g.text: Studs doubled on each side of the opening, (1)
Exterior wall opening over 2.4 m wide:
Fastened by screws, crimping or welding to
act as a single structural unit, (2)

svg.text: Studs are doubled on each side of every
opening where such openings involve more than
one stud space, and are tripled where the
openings in exterior walls exceed 2.4 m
Studs described in Sentence (1) are fastened
together by screws, crimping or welding to act
as a single structural unit in resisting
Drawn: C shows two studs back to back with screws. Opening sizes are illustration only.
